source_of_truth.note: The roadmap doc is the sole authority on phase scope and count (six phases, 0-5). This index and every contract file below must stay consistent with it; if they ever disagree, the roadmap doc wins and this kit needs correcting, not the other way around.

audit_status_note: A section-by-section bug audit of the live production source (vps/daveai-ui-v6.html, brain_llm.py, CSS, and infra scripts) produced 133 candidate findings; a majority have been independently confirmed real (see docs/DAVEAI_DEEP_AUDIT_ROADMAP_20260915.md and docs/DAVEAI_ARCHITECTURE_MAP_20260915.md §7 for the current exact count, since it may be updated after this index was written). The remainder are NOT confirmed-false, only pending re-verification. No consolidated ledger of all 133 findings exists in this repository as of 2026-09-15 — each contract below carries only the findings specifically flagged for its phase under known_findings.

status_discipline.verified: Read the code/data/live response directly, with evidence quoted.
status_discipline.reported: A document or another agent's proof artifact says so, not independently re-checked.
status_discipline.rule: Never upgrade a 'reported' fact to a 'verified' claim without re-checking it yourself.

phase_order_note: Phases 0-4 are a strict dependency chain (each depends on the last touching the same shared file, vps/daveai-ui-v6.html, or the same catalog mechanism). Phase 5 (CT-005) is not sequential with the rest — it is a standing decision register consulted both before Phase 0/1 start and again once CT-003/CT-004 land, not a phase to run once at the end.

contracts.title: Stop the Bleeding — Repo/Production Drift and Urgent Security Exposure
contracts.one_line_summary: Four low-risk repo-hygiene fixes that stop the repo from actively lying about what's live on daveai.tech, plus one urgent, narrowly-scoped security lockdown, before any feature work begins on the same files.

contracts.title: Chat Completion — Line-by-Line Audit and Fix Pass on the Real Chat Stack
contracts.one_line_summary: Top priority per the owner: a real line-by-line audit and fix pass on vps/daveai-ui-v6.html's chat logic and brain_llm.py — hung-state recovery, fetch/stream error handling, auth/session edge cases, the SSE parser, and voice/TTS wiring.

contracts.title: Menus, Tabs, Topbar/Sidebar Polish — Including the Accessibility Pass
contracts.one_line_summary: Same file as CT-001, different section (#topbar, sidebar icon rail, settings panels) plus a real accessibility pass, including the sign-in form and the ~23-toggle Settings modal.

contracts.title: Games Catalog Consolidation — One Real Source Instead of Five
contracts.one_line_summary: Collapses the five-places-at-once catalog mechanism into one real source, adds the missing web-pages.html source into the repo, and raises game test coverage beyond 'the page loads.'

contracts.title: Wildcard Site Extensibility — Wiring the 'Other' Category as the Launcher for External Sites
contracts.one_line_summary: Wires the existing but unused 'other' catalog category and embed:false launch-card rendering into a real path for adding the owner's other sites, once CT-003's registry is singular.

contracts.title: Open Strategic Questions — Decisions Needed From the Owner, Not Code Fixes
contracts.one_line_summary: A standing decision register, not an implementation contract: the dead voice/IPTV/TV stack, the bolt Cloudflare Pages deployment's fate, pacing/go-ahead, the unlocated Alice's Arena thread, and whether to revive the daveai-v7 modularization.

shared_file_warning.rule: This is one 12,920-line hand-written file with no build pipeline. CT-000/001/002/003/004 all touch it in different, non-overlapping sections. Do not start a later contract's edits to this file until the earlier contract's changes are merged, and never edit it from two contracts at once without explicit coordination — line numbers cited in a not-yet-started contract will silently go stale the moment an earlier one lands.

notes: Every contract file's status must only ever move off 'not_started' with dated evidence attached matching that contract's required_evidence and definition_of_done — never edit this index's status field ahead of that evidence existing.

This index does not duplicate each contract's forbidden_claim_patterns, protected_paths, or full known_findings detail — read the contract file itself (docs/contracts/CT-0XX-*.json) before starting any work; this index is for navigation and dependency ordering only, not a substitute for it.
As of 2026-09-15 all six contracts are not_started; Phase 0/1 work has an explicit go/no-go gate of its own — see CT-005's Q3 — which must be answered before CT-000 or CT-001 status changes.
